execution_order: Commit this superseding cloud preregistration, schemas, fixtures, provider policy, and network/privacy guards before the first completion request.
At every run, require the exact task-private credential file mode 0600 and re-prove rpi resolves only to Tailscale, the route uses tailscale0, and Tailscale ping succeeds.
Send only the committed public synthetic fixtures to model alias deepseek-v4-flash; reject redirects, any other alias, extra request field, forbidden role, or non-fixture content before network I/O.
Run the 14 fixed quality prompts once, then all 12 marked prompts for three complete rounds at concurrency 1, 2, and 4.
Run four deterministic 3584-input-token pressure requests, then cancellation of one request during a four-request batch with peer and replacement observations.
Store content-bearing output only under the authorized Slice 2 cache; track numeric aggregates, identities, gate results, hashes, safe usage counts, and content-free error classes only.
If every component gate passes, request blind quality scoring and then repeat the complete winning configuration; otherwise record no cloud selection and do not try another alias/provider.
Never extend this test exception to private/live transcripts, production activation, another endpoint, another alias, cloud STT/TTS, implicit defaults, or fallback.

measurement.percentile_method: Nearest-rank percentile over each complete preregistered set; p95 rank ceil(0.95 × N), p50 rank ceil(0.50 × N), and lower-tail p05 rank ceil(0.05 × N).
measurement.quality: Run all 14 committed Russian prompts sequentially with one unscored public priming prompt; retain visible output only in the cache for blind 0-4 rubric scoring.
measurement.parallel: For each concurrency level 1, 2, and 4, submit all 12 marked public requests in complete batches for three rounds; record submit, HTTP acceptance, raw-first-delta, visible-first-content, every output event, completion, numeric usage, response model, and content-free error class.
measurement.context_pressure: Submit four concurrent deterministic requests built only from committed public fixture text to approximately 3584 input tokens each, bounded by the 4096-token context declaration and 512 generated tokens.
measurement.cancellation: At concurrency four, close one streaming response after observable output begins while three peers continue, then submit one replacement; record cancel-to-last-output, peer regression, admission, stale output, marker isolation, and gateway recovery without alias change.
measurement.sustained: Use the three complete parallel rounds as the sustained window; report per-round success, latency, throughput, fairness, and monotonic client RAM trend without provider-content logging.
measurement.repeat: After all component and blind-quality gates pass, rerun quality, every 1/2/4 round, context pressure, cancellation, and privacy/identity checks with the exact endpoint, alias, fixture hashes, request fields, and credential source.
measurement.raw_evidence: Content-bearing responses and sanitized transport diagnostics remain under /home/priney/.cache/voice-agent-v2/slice-2/raw/cloud/; tracked results contain no prompt, response, token, environment, request ID, or user/session content.

selection_rule: Select cloud mode with deepseek-v4-flash only if every preregistered quality, identity, transport, privacy, latency, throughput, fairness, cancellation, sustained, context-pressure, and repeat gate passes. Any failure preserves no LLM selection; never test another alias or fallback automatically.
